_about: Public-domain Jabez Burns (1805-1876), General Baptist minister of Church Street, Paddington, and temperance preacher, for the Word Hoard: Sermons chiefly designed for Family Reading (1842), The Christian's Daily Portion (1842), Sketches of Sermons on Christian Missions (1845), Christian Philosophy (1845), The Pulpit Cyclopaedia (1845), Sketches of Sermons on the Parables and Miracles (1847), Mothers of the Wise and Good (1850), Sermons for the Sick Room (1854) and A Retrospect of Forty-five Years' Christian Ministry (1875). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 76 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jburns-family-sermons: Sermons chiefly designed for family reading and village worship (London : Houlston and Stoneman, 1842)
jburns-daily-portion: The Christian's daily portion, or golden pot of manna : containing three hundred and sixty-five exercises on the person, offices, work, and glory of the redeemer (London : J. H. Starie, 1842)
jburns-missions-sketches: Sketches of sermons on Christian missions, original and selected (London, Aylott and Jones, 1845)
jburns-christian-philosophy: Christian philosophy : or, Materials for thought (London : Houlston and Stoneman, 1845)
jburns-pulpit-cyclopaedia: The pulpit cyclopaedia, and Christian minister's companion : containing three hundred and sixty skeletons and sketches of sermons (New York : D. Appleton & Co., 1845)
jburns-parables-miracles: Sketches of sermons on the parables and miracles of Christ : the essentials of saving religion, etc (London : Houlston and Stoneman, 1847)
jburns-mothers-wise-good: Mothers of the wise and good (Boston : Gould, Kendall and Lincoln, 1850)
jburns-sick-room-sermons: Sermons designed for the sick room, family reading and village worship (catalogued 1854)
jburns-retrospect: A Retrospect of Forty-five Years' Christian Ministry: Public Work in Other Spheres of Benevolent (Houlston, 1875)
